pages.title: Store on the Player
pages.text: Create a hit trigger with a keyword action. Set target self and keyword mastery:thunder. Each successful proc adds stacks to the player instead of the enemy. Chance and cooldown determine how quickly it charges.

pages.title: Spend the Charge
pages.text: In the thunder keyword Threshold actions, add lightning targeting nearby, center self. Set radius and limit, then amount. Enable consume_stacks so reaching the threshold spends charge before the next activation.

pages.title: Add Presentation
pages.text: Add electric_spark particles on self and nearby targets. You can replace lightning with a native spell action, or add an effect action. Each action may have its own conditions and chance.

pages.title: Test Both Sides
pages.text: Give the test player the owning skill and hit a hostile entity. Verify charge rate, target range, damage, allies, and stack consumption. Saving valid data checks syntax and references; it does not prove your intended balance.
